name: Micro Stats
description: WebGL background made of a grid of tiny rounded slats whose size and brightness follow animated wave fields, with a fluid cursor wake that disturbs them and a fade-in intro.
contents: Single container div holding an OGL WebGL2 canvas of slats
Four wave presets: swell, tide, storm, signal
behavior: Slat grid rendered in a shader, driven by animated wave fields with glint highlights
Pointer movement and press inject force into a small fluid simulation that pushes the slats
Intro animation plays on mount for introDuration seconds
Render loop pauses when the tab is hidden or when paused is true
Resolution is capped by a pixel budget and device pixel ratio of 2
editableByProps: Wave preset and every wave parameter (scale, speed, direction, chop, stretch, glint, contrast, perspective, fog)
Cursor interaction on or off, strength, size, swirl, trail and lean
Intro on or off and its duration, pause, container className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the preset values or add a new preset
Change fluid simulation resolution or pressure quality
Raise or lower the resolution cap

fixed: Requires the ogl npm package and WebGL2, nothing renders if WebGL2 is unavailable
Container is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a height or the canvas collapses
Pointer, blur and visibility listeners are attached to window and document while mounted and removed on unmount
Pointer effects react to the pointer anywhere on the window while it is inside the container area, the canvas itself is not interactive
Cursor effects and animation are disabled when the user prefers reduced motion
Colors are parsed through a canvas 2D context, so any CSS color string works, invalid ones fall back to defaults
Preset is read once per render, unknown preset falls back to swell
Works on small screens, the canvas resizes with the container, and the pointer wake responds to any pointer type, including touch drags

options.look: Rolling ocean-like waves with medium chop, perspective depth and fog
options.useWhen: A hero background for a product landing page that needs a lively but balanced motion

options.look: Slower, smoother and softer waves with slight stretch and lower glint
options.useWhen: A calm backdrop behind wellness, finance or editorial content where text must stay readable

options.look: Small, fast, highly chopped slats with strong contrast and glint
options.useWhen: An intense hero for a game, music event or high-energy launch page

options.look: Flat, stretched horizontal bars with no perspective or fog, like a data signal
options.useWhen: A tech or data dashboard landing section that needs a flat graphic equalizer look
